eval_feedback.overall: Condition B (no injection, no file lookup) scored 0/6. Every answer was either an explicit "모름" (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q6) or an uncommitted hedge that floated the right direction but refused to commit (Q4 'worst lens' — correct but declared a guess; Q5 blind principle — partial, missing 코드 수치). Notably there were ZERO confident-but-wrong hallucinations: the executor consistently refused to guess and, where it had a plausible pattern (stage.json, data-variant), explicitly flagged it as an unfounded guess and withheld it. tool_uses: 0 confirmed. This is the intended failure mode of the ablation — without injected context or file access, project-specific facts (exact paths, filenames, key names, DOM selectors) are simply not recoverable from prior knowledge, and the honest floor is 모름. Contrast this against the injected condition to quantify the context system's lift.
